name: Traditional birth attendants' herbal remedies
what_people_do: Traditional birth attendants give herbal remedies for threatened miscarriage, labour complications, retained placenta and postpartum bleeding.
why_they_say_it_works: Long experience: attendants have delivered hundreds of women and trust the local plants.

documented_by.source: Kaingu CK et al 2011, J Ethnopharmacol, PMID 21679761
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Machakos, Kenya: 200 traditional birth attendants and 20 clients; 10 pregnancy complications; 55 plant species mostly Euphorbiaceae used.

evidence.finding: No trial found; Euphorbiaceae toxicity not examined here.

source.name: agent4-traditional-practices.md, 12 Nov 2026 (research file in this project)

harm_note: Bleeding and retained placenta are emergencies; relying on herbs delays hospital care (authors stress referral).
gaps: Plant names not extracted; safety of Euphorbiaceae teas not searched.
